comment: mneme-cf-bundle/v1 conformance operations — the world is a function of this list. No clock, no randomness: every timestamp derives from a fixed base counter, embeddings are the deterministic local tokenizer, the signing seed is a fixed TEST-ONLY key. Regenerating must produce byte-identical artifacts.

operations.text: The deploy gate requires staging to pass.
Auth tokens expire after one hour.
Queue depth alerts at ten thousand.
